description: AdCamp Video System for Windows (Preview) by Chris Serra.

plugins.name: avs
plugins.description: The Windows preview of AdCamp Video System: turns a phone video of you talking, plus your script, into a finished, captioned vertical video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, Meta ads) on your own Windows PC. A preview: tested by an automated Windows install, few people have used it on a real PC yet.
